subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Someone who lives in solitude
solution:
The correct answer is: **Recluse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• A **recluse **is someone who lives in solitude or seclusion. (कोई व्यक्ति जो एकांत या एकांत में रहता हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *The writer lived as a recluse in a secluded cabin, finding solace in the quietude of nature.*
 
 
 
• The word '**solitude**' means the state of being alone or isolated.
 
• The grammatical point here is the use of the noun 'recluse' to describe someone who prefers to live alone.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Metropolitan **refers to a person who lives in a big city. (एक व्यक्ति जो एक बड़े शहर में रहता है)
 
• **Cosmopolitan **refers to a person who is well-traveled and has a broad knowledge of different cultures. (एक व्यक्ति जो अच्छी तरह से यात्रा करता है और विभिन्न संस्कृतियों का व्यापक ज्ञान रखता है)
 
• **Refugee **refers to a person who has been forced to leave their home country due to persecution or war. (वह व्यक्ति जिसे उत्पीड़न या युद्ध के कारण अपना देश छोड़ने के लिए मजबूर किया गया हो)
